messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy kicked off for release v2.14.0 -> canary (10% traffic). Release notes: https://redwood.ai/releases/v2.14.0 | Observability: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/embeds/canary-dashboard | Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC
soma: watching the canary, will post SLO snapshot in ~45s
observability-bot: [ALERT] embeds-service: 5xx rate = 1.8% (SLO target 0.5%) on canary cohort, spike started ~30s after shift. p95 latency jumped to 420ms. Link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/alert/98765
nate: seeing the same in traces — errors are mostly backend 502s from the quantized-serving path. Can we pause the traffic shift and pin to previous model version for canary? @maya
soma: pausing traffic shift now — running: 
```
/redwoodctl deploy pause --release v2.14.0 --reason "5xx spike on canary"
```
(deploy-bot: acknowledged)
deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused. Canary remains at 10% but new rollforward steps halted.
maya: agree with pin for canary only. Will route canary back to v2.13.9 for embeds. Command: 
```
/orch route set --service embeds --version v2.13.9 --cohort canary --percent 10
```
I'll run it now.
nate: collecting quick logs for the canary pods: 
```
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=embeds -c model-server --since=1m | grep -E "ERROR|Timeout" | tail -n 40
```
seeing repeated "KV cache miss -> fallback to quantized executor: timeout" entries around shard 7.
soma: looks like the new quantized kernels are hitting a timeout path under certain request patterns. Might be a compatibility/regression with v2.14.0 build of the runtime.
observability-bot: SLO snapshot after canary pinning attempt: canary 5xx dropped to 0.42% within 25s of routing change. Alert cleared.
maya: rollback/pin succeeded for canary cohort. Recommendation: hold full rollout, open post-deploy incident for root cause and revert quantized kernel change in next patch.
soma: marking release as PAUSED and pinning v2.13.9 for canary. Adding note to release: "Hold: backend 5xx spike observed in canary; pinned to previous version; investigating."
jen: (product) thanks for the quick response — will update customer-facing release calendar and the internal rollout tracker. Keep me posted on timeline.
nate: creating a short ticket for ops/research: "v2.14.0 quantized executor timeouts on shard 7 — investigate fallback path and add better kvcache metrics" and attaching canary logs. :white_check_mark:
soma: agreed — we'll run an eval harness on the failing prompt set and run a smaller internal canary once the kernel fix lands.
maya: re: next steps — propose rollback of the quantized kernel change in runtime 0.9.4 -> 0.9.3 and a focused smoke test: 1000 inferences with the problematic shard routing.
soma: sounds good. I'll coordinate with infra and schedule the re-rollout window once we have a patch. Thanks everyone for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
